title: Ore dake Level Up na Ken: ReAwakening
content:
Don’t you love it when the production company packages a long recap for your favorite Anime and brands it as a movie? I should hate this trend, but at least, at the time of release, this recap did include the first two episodes of season two which was unreleased then. I guess they had to justify paying for theater tickets somehow. It worked.

This might be controversial, but I think Manhwa based Anime are easier to recap than traditional Manga counterparts. All you’d be doing is scrolling vertically to some extent, so that translates better to an animated recap I think. It’s easier to miss detailand nuance originally so recaps are swallowed easily in this context. And I, for one, hate recaps.

I’m gonna let this one slide because, first, it’s season one of Solo Leveling, nothing really that exciting happened up to that point and people should as hell would want a refresher because of how atrocious a lot of viewers thought the direction was and how many characters were shown without proper time and exposition to flesh them out, and second, two early episodes of the next season at the time of release. So there was a hype preceding this.

Whether season one was inferior to season two or vice versa, I’ll leave this discussion to some other time, but sure as hell the quality jump was noticeable once the two season two episodes content is shown.

Overall: 7.26/10.
